messages:
susan (pm): Hey product — Zephyr Pay inbound request: they need a private/on-prem deployment with HSM + optional airgapped mode. Sales says pilot target is 2026-08-31. Can we triage feasibility, major blockers, and a rough timeline? Copying sales/support.

raj (sales): FYI — Zephyr is a mid-market payment processor. Must be PCI-DSS compliant, want customer-managed keys via HSM, prefer on-prem but will consider Dedicated if timeline slips. Pilot deadline is firm; competitor in play. Docs: https://zephyr.example.com/reqs (shared with the customer).

marta (support): They hit two issues in sandbox: tokenization mismatch with quantized models. Logged as #876 and #878. Customer expects those resolved before pilot.

tom (eng): High-level: on-prem is doable but depends on infra constraints. Need answers: GPU type & count, expected qps/latency, network egress policy (can we reach a control-plane proxy?), HSM vendor and SDK version, and whether FIPS is required.

olivia (security): Must confirm PCI scope and proof points. We'll need KMS/HSM integration, key import policy, and attestation for keys. Airgap will require an offline installer and license flow; legal will need to review data flow diagram.

raj (sales): Quick details from customer: GPU pilot = 2x A10G, target peak ~50 qps. P95 latency target <250ms. Outbound egress is very restricted — they allow a single proxy endpoint to reach our control plane. HSM: YubiHSM 2 preferred. No scope expansion for PCI.

susan (pm): OK. Drafting two scope options:
- Option A (MVP): VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS + YubiHSM integration, remote control-plane allowed via customer proxy.
- Option B (Airgap): Full offline bundle + offline installer, telemetry disabled, longer lead time.
Which is realistic for a pilot by 2026-08-31?

tom (eng): Timeline estimates: Option A ~6 weeks (env prep, KMS integration, config, canary). Option B ~14 weeks (offline bundle, installer, HSM airgap testing, runbook). Major deps: network certs, HSM SDK compatibility, infra access windows, and QA cycles for quantization fixes.

marta (support): We'll need their perf traces and eval prompts before QA. Also need exact input distribution to validate quantization/regression issues.

olivia (security): Minimum launch criteria:
1) PCI scope diagram approved by security
2) KMS/HSM keys verified with attestation
3) Audit logging to customer's SIEM configured
4) Performance SLO met on pilot nodes
5) Rollback plan and canary policy
If any of these are missing, we can't sign off for go-live.

tom (eng): Quick triage checklist I'm adding for the intake ticket:
```
- infra: subnet/CIDR/VPN details
- control plane: proxy endpoint + cert thumbprint
- HSM: vendor, SDK version, test keys, attestation method
- compliance: PCI contact, required artifacts
- perf: expected qps, latency target, sample workload
- access: admin accounts + windows for ssh/kubectl
- quantization: model version + tokenization tests
```
Satisfying these reduces unknowns.

susan (pm): Action items: raj to get infra template and introduce Zephyr infra lead; Zephyr to provide perf workload + test keys; tom to validate HSM SDK compatibility; olivia to start PCI artifact checklist. We'll sync Tue 10am next week. If Option A is blocked we escalate to sales engineering.

raj (sales): I'll introduce their infra lead (thomas) and send the infra template today. I'll also flag that Option A is preferred to hit their target.

tom (eng): I'll spike a YubiHSM 2 POC this week and post compatibility notes. Will also reproduce the tokenization mismatch with quantized models.

olivia (security): I'll draft the PCI artifact list in Confluence and notify legal for review.

deploy-bot: New runbook created (draft): https://confluence.redwood/integrations/zephyr-onprem-runbook.

susan (pm): Thanks all — marking this thread product-triage. I'll update intake ticket PROD-4821 with scope options, timelines, and the triage checklist. Keep updates in this thread so we have a single source for decisions.
